symptom.detail: HTTP 529 overloaded_error during CE schema repair

dynamic_evidence.first_missing_retry_boundary: The non-streaming CE repair command set metadata.max_retries=0. Request preparation projected this as the provider transport retry budget, so MiniMax returned the first transient 529 directly despite its implemented 5xx backoff loop.

root_cause: The CE schema-repair path conflated a bounded semantic reconstruction policy with physical transport resilience. Setting max_retries=0 prevented even one byte-identical retry for a transient provider 5xx/529 response.

fix.behavior: Give every non-streaming CE repair exactly one transport-only retry. The frozen request, PM authority, TaskRuntime claim, output contract, semantic round, and deadline remain unchanged; only a transient physical 5xx can re-send the same governed request once.

verification.red: Exact CE schema-repair command test observed metadata.max_retries=0 instead of 1.
